distinct_inferential_role: Determines whether construct-relevant AI could contribute directly to the scored response and therefore whether the score targets joint human-AI or reduced-assistance human performance.
why_not_redundant: Holding delay/overlap/transfer/non-use evidence fixed cannot recover whether AI was actually available during response production.
worked_evidence_anchor: Wong & Qiu separate an AI-assisted creative task from a subsequent unassisted creative-transfer task.
claim_boundary: A alone does not establish learning; it identifies the assistance condition of the scored response.

distinct_inferential_role: Separates concurrent/immediate performance from persistence or retention-related claims by locating the outcome in time relative to the last relevant assisted exposure.
why_not_redundant: An AI-free outcome immediately after practice and an AI-free outcome weeks later can share A/O/G/N but support different temporal interpretations.
worked_evidence_anchor: Zhou et al. include independent assessments at Day 7, Day 30, and Day 60 after the assisted period.
claim_boundary: Delay strengthens a retention interpretation only when the assessed construct and other regime components also support it.

distinct_inferential_role: Distinguishes repeated or same-content performance from assessment on materially different content.
why_not_redundant: Novelty/transfer demand cannot be inferred from labels such as post-test; repeated items can yield robust post-assistance effects without demonstrating generalization.
worked_evidence_anchor: Pardos & Bhandari include a post-test with repeated items from earlier work.
claim_boundary: Overlap is a measurement descriptor, not a claim that repetition invalidates an outcome.

distinct_inferential_role: Records how far the assessed task departs from supported practice, separating item novelty from the strength of the transfer claim.
why_not_redundant: Two novel tasks can both have O=novel while requiring very different near/far/domain-shift generalization.
worked_evidence_anchor: Wong & Qiu move from improving a product to inventing a different product; Ates et al. use delayed AI-free scientific-argument transfer.
claim_boundary: G describes the intended generalization demand; it does not itself validate construct equivalence.

dimension: Evidence and scope of AI non-use
distinct_inferential_role: Records what evidence supports the claim that construct-relevant AI was not used and what functions were restricted.
why_not_redundant: A report can state that AI was intended to be absent while providing no monitoring or prevention evidence; A=removed and N=unclear are therefore logically distinct.
worked_evidence_anchor: Guo et al. describe supervised post-tests with external resources prevented; several screened studies leave post-test AI status insufficiently specified.
claim_boundary: N is evidence about non-use, not proof that all assistance or contamination was impossible.
